name: Seth Wilson
headline: IT NetSuite Professional
about:
A chaos tolerant, professional, NetSuite application developer with many facets of experience in Information Technology. My experience has taught me to identify where to concentrate energy and effort to complete projects on time, and within project budget and scope. I thrive on new challenges, and I have the correct mix of technical skills and business acumen to complement any team.

Some technologies I am presently exploring are:
- Netsuite Suitescript 2.1
- Swift 5
- AI
- Ruby and the Sinatra Web Framework
- Twilio Telephony API
… more

experiences.description:
Highlighted projects with NetSuite SuiteScript 2.0:

- Package Tracking: Utilized SuiteScript 2.0 and our shipping carrier's APIs to track the actual delivery date of our packages sent to customers.  Used this tool during the COVID pandemic to decide which shipping carriers were meeting their promised delivery date agreements and would adjust on the fly the promised delivered date to our customers if there were any lags or delays from the carriers.

- Customer Lifetime Value Calculation: Utilized SuiteScript 2.0 Map/Reduce framework to calculate the Lifetime Value (LTV) for over 400,000 customers over 11 years

- TakeStock:  A custom iOS application with NetSuite RESTlet integration that speeds up the inventory adjustment process for 11,000 SKUs.
